scientific_integrity: The infinite-rank first-passage law is supported by an analytical proof; finite exact-rational and numerical checks are supplementary, not exhaustive. Related papers supply the underlying Gaussian estimator and independence premise. Potential historical general extreme-value specializations are not excluded.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed-width independent standard-real-Gaussian batches, the unmodified single-node same-fresh-batch relative Frobenius ratio, flat nonzero singular spectrum, exact arithmetic and ranks divisible by batch width are covered; no complete hierarchical or batch-averaged implementation claim.
title: Sequential Gaussian Frobenius stopping has a sharp premature-rank law
